items.title: Tyler Warren: Added to injury report, questionable
items.text:
Warren (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Titans after being added to the practice report Friday as a limited participant.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Will come off exempt list Monday
items.text:
Jacobs (personal) will be removed from the Commissioner's Exempt List on Monday and be eligible to play as soon as the Packers' Week 7 game at Detroit, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Questionable due to illness
items.text:
Metcalf  is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers after missing Friday's practice due to an illness.
